description: Use when an agent tracks large stablecoin flows (whale alerts). Input: chain (ethereum, base, arbitrum), optional token (USDC, USDT), min_usd (default 100000), minutes (Ethereum ≤30, Base ≤5, Arbitrum ≤10), limit (default 25). Output: JSON transfers sorted by size with total/returned/truncated, totalUsd (returned rows) and totalUsdAll (window), from/to entity labels + OFAC flags, mint/burn, tx link. Example: ?chain=ethereum&min_usd=1000000 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

limit.description: Max transfers returned (default 25); total/returned/truncated report the rest

minutes.description: Look-back window (default Ethereum 10, Base 2, Arbitrum 5; max 30 / 5 / 10). Out of range → 400 before payment

token.description: Stablecoin (default all on the chain; Base has USDC only)

name: stablecoin_transfers
title: Whale stablecoin transfers: large USDC/USDT moves on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum with entity labels and OFAC flags
